Unify real-time customer data, 2D visual automation graphs, and omnichannel pipelines on a high-throughput relational foundation.

blocks.columnA:

Native database-enforced multi-tenant isolation ensures zero cross-tenant data leakage risk.

Distributed Redis message broker capable of processing 25,000+ workflow jobs per minute with automatic jitter.
